title: The Man Who Survived Two Atomic Bombs: Tsutomu Yamaguchi #shorts
description:
Did you know this story? 👇

The true story of Tsutomu Yamaguchi, the man who survived both atomic bombs, Hiroshima and Nagasaki, in August 1945.
Around 160 people are believed to have lived through both blasts, but Japan officially recognized only one of them, and not until 2009.

description:

The Kola hole reached about 7.6 miles, only 0.2% of the way to the Earth's center.

description:

description:
Tides, nights, or eclipses: which would you keep? 👇

What happens if the Moon disappears? We bust 5 myths about Earth without the Moon: orbit, tides, animals, seasons and more. Bonus fact: the Moon is already drifting away about 1.5 inches every year, and the last total solar eclipse will happen in roughly 600 million years. #whatif #moon #space #science #curiosities

title: What If You Could See Who Has a Crush on You?
description:

What if you could see who has a crush on you? A pink number floats above every head and thin threads show who likes whom. Follow the consequences through high school, work, friendship and the whole world, until a stranger on the subway changes everything.

title: What If Every Human Disappeared? The Last Thing Left of Us
description:
What would you leave behind for 10,000 years? 👇

What happens if every human disappears from Earth? Follow the planet at 1 hour, 1 day, 1 year, 100 years and 10,000 years to find the last proof that we ever existed.
The New York subway pumps out about 13 million gallons of groundwater every day, and without humans it starts to flood in about a day and a half. And Mount Rushmore's granite erodes only about 1 inch every 10,000 years.
What would you leave behind for 10,000 years?
#whatif #worldwithoutus #earth #curiosities
